sequence: Additional frozen self-supervised baseline fixed while the ConvNeXt/Belgium extension was running; original GTSRB and some new ConvNeXt outcomes were already known
model: Official DINOv2 ViT-S/14 distilled, no registers, frozen normalized class-token output (384 dimensions)
source: facebookresearch/dinov2, resolved commit and source archive checksum recorded by dino_download.py
preprocessing: Same registered per-dataset crops and direct 224x224 ImageNet-normalized resize as extension; FP16 autocast and cache
probe: Unit-normalized signed features; multinomial logistic regression on all retained target training labels
interpretation: One deterministic probe fit per dataset, no seed SD. Pretraining data and objective differ from ImageNet-supervised models, so differences do not isolate architecture or target label efficiency. No full fine-tuning or universal state-of-the-art claim.
